Item 8.01. Other Events.
On November 9, 2026, Strive, Inc. ("Strive" or the "Company") announced that during the period from October 31, 2026 through November 6, 2026, Strive purchased 29 bitcoin at an average price of approximately $75,721 per bitcoin, inclusive of fees and expenses. The Company also announced the following updates to its holdings of cash and cash equivalents, bitcoin, and Variable Rate Series A Perpetual Stretch Preferred Stock of Strategy Inc.
